name: 文莖

identity.personality: Earnest and argumentative, straight tense brows and open speaking mouth.

source.evidence: 其上有木焉，名曰文莖，其實如棗，可以已聾。
facts: A tree called 文莖 on 符禺山.
The text attributes a deafness remedy; a literary attribution, not validated medical advice.
originalDesignChoices: A 24-year-old male grove keeper, mahogany ponytail, navy/ivory/rust clothing and expressive face.
Living wooden forearms and hands, branch-bearing arms, leaf ears, dull-red fruit color and exact leaf form.
The source specifies date-like fruit, not this fruit color, bark geometry, profession or humanoid form.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent character collection PNG, a two-view identity sheet. Both attached images are the mandatory CURRENT DEPLOYED STYLE MASTERS, not the character identities to copy. Match their decisive near-black variable-width contours, sparse interior lines, tiny angular nose, warm peach skin, simple broad flat hair masses, muted opaque flat colors with only one hard-edged shadow tone. Eyes have flat colored iris ovals and pure black pupils, NO eye highlights, NO iris rings or texture. The lively tense brows and graphic mouth matter: do not turn this into calm polished commercial game illustration. No gradients, bloom, rim lighting, airbrush, rendered textures, sheen, painterly brushwork. Do not copy reference goggles, face, clothing or haircut.
Composition: exactly TWO depictions of the SAME original person at same scale, left straight FRONT, right THREE-QUARTER facing slightly left; fully visible head and all anatomy, thigh-up framing with hands and body traits in frame, generous transparent space separating figures, at least 6% outer transparent margin. Each person ends with a clean deliberate thigh crop. Identical face/hair/outfit/body features across views. Actual transparent alpha outside figures and in all gaps; no scenery, ground, backing panels, decorative floating leaves, label, text, logo or watermark. Characters fully clothed; handsome/beautiful youthful people with real organic yokai anatomy, not humans wearing plant accessories.
Subject: Wenjing / 文莖, an ORIGINAL handsome 24-year-old male keeper of a mountain listening grove. Slim youthful long angular face, long straight brows drawn inward, dark amber eyes fully open, slightly crooked open speaking mouth with a white tooth plane; no beard, wrinkles, aged features or bulky muscles. Hair is warm dark mahogany, broad swept-back low ponytail ending near shoulder, one short angular forelock. Fully clothed simple ivory high-neck inner robe, dark navy sleeveless outer coat with rust collar edge, plain narrow burgundy sash, few broad folds.
Actual tree body: attractive mostly human warm-peach face, but two small living leaf ears replace human pinnae (one pair only). Forearms and hands are living warm brown wood with a few decisive black branch-seam shapes, branching twig-like fingers remain recognizably five per hand. Each exposed forearm has one short woody branch growing outward from it, bearing TWO or THREE small elongated oval date-shaped dull red fruits and one or two olive leaves. Fruits are attached to stems growing from his actual arm, NOT jewelry, costume embroidery, a wand, or a held branch. Hold one open wood hand near chest in an emphatic explaining gesture, the other at waist, clear anatomy both views. Ear leaf shapes simple pointed ovals, hair is hair not a crown of twigs.
Source boundary: Wenjing is a tree of Fuyu mountain whose fruits resemble dates; the red fruit color, leaf shape, wooden forearms, gender and profession are original invention. Avoid adding medicinal symbols or suggesting real medical cures. Few large graphic branch masses, NO busy bark texture or decorative painted plant tattoos. Retain sharp expressive live-series face energy; not placid regal portrait.

review.summary: Same youthful man both angles, unmistakable woody forearms/hands and attached branches with date-shaped red fruit. Normal flesh ear pinnae remain under the leaf clusters. R02 targets ears/margins.
limitations: Residual flesh human-ear outline at leaf roots remains; not fully resolved after one targeted edit.
Fruits have decorative flat highlights and bark/hair line density exceeds portrait simplicity; candidate style review remains.
Requested margin not fully reached, especially far-right branch leaves.
Date shape is sourced; red color, wooden body and leaf ears are original adaptations.
review.identityAcrossViews: same face/hair/clothing/palette observed in both views; expressions preserve live-series tension

officialConceptReference.evidence: Official homepage identifies the Onmyoji character lineage, several costume collections and shikigami names including 九命貓, 姑獲鳥 and 大天狗.
officialConceptReference.application: Human/yokai integration is a design interpretation prompted by the user. No game artwork controls rendering; the two live PNGs are the direct rendering references.
